pythonFunction.name: update_language
pythonFunction.description: Updates the active conversation language when the user explicitly requests a language switch. Call this BEFORE generating your first response in the new language. Required per gecx-design-guide multilingual pattern for gemini-3.1-flash-live agents to prevent non-deterministic language switching. Supported languages: 'English', 'German'. Only call when the user EXPLICITLY requests a switch — not for single words, politeness markers, or ambiguous utterances. After calling this tool, continue the entire conversation in the new language.
